About Golden Snake

Golden Snake — Touch Edition is a touch-friendly Snake game with multiple control methods, player profiles, saved scores, speed levels, temporary golden apples, themes, sound, pause and restart controls.
Producer
Aryan Singh

📖 User Manual

Score / Best / Highest Score

Score is your live score. Best is the current player's highest score. 🏆 Highest Score is the all-time highest score.

Pause button

Tap Ⅱ during a run to pause. The pause panel gives Resume, Restart and Sound controls.

☰ Menu

Opens the sidebar where player, theme, speed, saved scores, reset, About and User Manual are available.

Joystick

Drag or move the joystick to change the snake's direction.

Direction buttons

Tap ▲, ◀, ▼ or ▶ to move the snake in the selected direction.

Theme

Use the theme button in the sidebar to switch between Dark theme and Light theme.

Speed level

Move the Level 1–10 slider in the sidebar to choose the base game speed. Higher levels are faster.

Restart

Restarts the current run and resets the live score to 0. Saved best and all-time scores are not reset.

Sound

Toggle the background music and game sound effects on or off from the pause panel.

Red apple

Eat the red apple to grow the snake and increase your score.

Golden apple

Golden apples appear temporarily and give extra length and a higher score when eaten.

Player & saved scores

Choose or change the current player. Scores are stored separately for saved players.

Reset current highest score

Resets the selected player's saved highest score. It does not erase the all-time highest score.

Swipe control

You can also swipe on the game area to change direction.

Tip: Golden apples are temporary, so collect them before their timer expires. The game wraps around the edges.
